text:
Maya: FYI Snyk + our nightly scan flagged a few Python issues. tokenizers appears to have a memory exposure CVE (CVE-2025-4182). transformers has couple of lower-sev transitive issues. A transitive bump pulled starlette 0.27 and several FastAPI websocket tests are failing in CI.

Kevin: Prioritize tokenizers CVE. If ingestion pipelines can be triggered, treat as P0 for hosted. Need a quick CI unblock so devs can keep shipping.

Samir: Reproduced the CI failure locally. Failing in tests/http/test_websocket.py: 
``
E AttributeError: module 'starlette.websockets' has no attribute 'WebSocketDisconnect'
tests/http/test_websocket.py:22
```
Starlette moved/renamed websocket API. Not a security issue but blocks release.

Julia: Triage notes: CVE-2025-4182 (tokenizers) provisional severity: High (possible data exposure), CVSS ~7.8. Transformers deps: Medium. Starlette change: breakage only.

ci-bot: Pipeline #9876 failed on branch fix/poetry-lock. https://ci.internal/build/9876

Maya: Proposed plan:
1) Minimal PR bumping tokenizers to a fixed upstream release or apply upstream patch; regenerate poetry.lock only for that package.
2) Add constraints/pip_constraints.txt pinning starlette==0.26.1 to avoid upgrading in CI until we fix tests.
3) Schedule follow-up PR for transformers bump + run full model evals.
4) Pin cryptography to 40.x in test env to avoid new wheel/ABI issues seen last week.

Kevin: Also create a canary rollout for the tokenizers patch (small % of hosted traffic). Watch audit logs, latency, error rates.

Samir: Quick CI workaround: modify .github/workflows/pytest.yml to inject env var and use pip constraints during test-install: 
``
env:
  PYPI_CONSTRAINTS: constraints/pip_constraints.txt
steps:
  - run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt -c $PYPI_CONSTRAINTS
```
This avoids regenerating the whole lockfile while we do targeted updates.

Julia: Add an entry in security-triage doc: CVE id, affected components (ingest/tokenization/transform), mitigation steps, SLAs impacted, and customer advisory draft. If we escalate, I'll open an incident channel.

Maya: I'll open a draft PR: branch fix/deps/tokenizers-4182, include only lockfile changes for tokenizers, add constraints file, and a short changelog note. Assigning @Kevin and @Samir for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: run smoke tests on Dedicated and Private staging after merge. Queued job #4521.

Kevin: After review, cut hotfix for Hosted + Dedicated. For Private customers, publish advisory and provide patch bundle instructions.

Samir: Note: transformers minor bump caused a GPU CI flake in model-quant tests. Gate that behind a canary job to avoid wide rollout.

Maya: I'll add CVE to vuln tracker, tag customer accounts that might be affected, and post canary rollout timestamps + audit log links here when live.

Julia: Ping incidents if any unusual telemetry or signs of exploitation. :thumbsup:

Kevin: LGTM :rocket:

Maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/redwood/inference/pulls/2345 — ci-bot started build #9880.

Samir: Taking the PR review. Will run Dedicated smoke tests once CI passes.

Maya: Updating vuln tracker and will post canary audit links in this thread.
